newsitem.title: USA: Tejas Gas raises Coral stake to 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tejas Gas raises Coral stake to 50 pct.

text.p: Tejas Gas Corp said it has accelerated the increase in its ownership in Coral Energy LP to 50 percent effective January 1.
Previously, Coral was owned one-third by Tejas and two-thirds by Shell Oil Co, a Royal Dutch/Shell Group subsidiary.
Tejas purchased the additional interest from Shell for undisclosed terms, spokesman James W. Whalen said.
He said the purchase represented early exercise of an option Tejas had to purchase the additional interest in late 1998 or 1999.
Coral, an independent natural gas, power and financial services company formed in late 1995, is ranked among the top six marketers of natural gas in the United States, Tejas said.
As previously announced, the company said, Shell Canada Ltd may acquire an equity interest in Coral in a transaction expected to close during the first quarter.
Coral now markets more than 6 billion cubic feet per day of natural gas compared to 3.7 billion per day when it first began operations in November 1995.
